imp.d: Add transactions from a file. Rows already imported are skipped, and rows that match ones you typed in by hand are merged.

wise.d: A CSV from Wise. Rows clear matching gaps.

bank.d: A CSV exported from your bank or card.

pos: Charges are shown as positive numbers (cards)

pension.d: The pension is entered by hand.

your.d: Lives in the database on this device. Automatic daily backups are in Backup and restore.

export.d: Choose what to export and the format.

full.d: Everything in one JSON file, to read or keep. To restore from a backup, use Backup and restore.

restore.d: Moving to a new device? Start here.

toast.downloaded: Downloaded money-export.json. Look in your Downloads folder.

pn.title: Update pension balance
pn.text: Updated by hand when you move money into it. It is kept out of net worth, reports and the forecast unless you switch it on in Reports.
pn.label: Current balance (₪)
